title: Sections of an etale sheaf pulled back to a connected geometric fibre
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], let $\bar s:\operatorname{Spec}\Omega\to S$ be a geometric point [def-weil-geometric-point], and let $F$ be a sheaf of sets on the small etale site $S_{\Et}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaf-of-sets], with geometric stalk $F_{\bar s}$ [def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks]. Let $h:U\to\operatorname{Spec}\Omega$ be a scheme over $\Omega$. The inverse image [lem-weil-pbc-sets-etale-inverse-image-composition-units] of $F$ along $U\to\operatorname{Spec}\Omega\to S$ is canonically the constant sheaf with value $F_{\bar s}$ on $U_{\Et}$ [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf]. If $U$ is nonempty and connected [def-weil-connected-scheme], its global sections are canonically $F_{\bar s}$. This identification is natural in $U$: for every $\Omega$-morphism $v:V\to U$, the pullback of the section corresponding to $a\in F_{\bar s}$ is the constant section with value $a$ on $V$, whether or not $V$ is connected.

source.place: Etale Cohomology, Lemma 59.39.3 (Tag 0A3H, label lemma-sections-upstairs), proof, final paragraph, lines 5052-5067; the constant-sheaf identification and naturality are the assertions used there

proof.text: Let $q:U\to S$ be the composite $U\to\operatorname{Spec}\Omega\xrightarrow{\bar s}S$. By [lem-weil-pbc-etale-geometric-fibre-inverse-image-constant], together with the canonical composition isomorphism and its unit compatibility from [lem-weil-pbc-sets-etale-inverse-image-composition-units], there is a canonical natural isomorphism $q^{-1}F\cong\underline{F_{\bar s}}$ on $U_{\Et}$. Thus the inverse image in the statement is the claimed constant sheaf.

source.place: Etale Cohomology, Lemma 59.39.3 (Tag 0A3H), final paragraph, lines 5052-5067

proof.text: Assume $U$ is nonempty and connected. Applying [lem-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf-set-sections-connected-natural] to the set $E=F_{\bar s}$ identifies $\Gamma(U,q^{-1}F)$ with $F_{\bar s}$ by sending $a$ to the corresponding constant section.

source.place: Remark 59.23.2 (Tag 03P5), set-valued constant sheaf sections on a connected nonempty scheme

proof.text: For an $\Omega$-morphism $v:V\to U$, naturality of the isomorphism in Step 1 and the naturality clause of [lem-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf-set-sections-connected-natural] identify the pullback of the section corresponding to $a\in F_{\bar s}$ with the constant section of value $a$ on $V$, independently of connectedness of $V$.
